plannedDateHelper: Choose a date when it helps make the next action concrete. You can always reschedule.
subtasksHelper: Break the task into small, concrete steps. Start with the easiest useful action.
focusHelper: Use a focus interval that fits the task. You can pause, shorten, or restart without losing progress.
intentionHelper: A specific if–then plan for when and where you will act can improve goal follow-through on average; results vary by person and task.
focusModeSummary: Showing your top {{count}} tasks to reduce visual load.
